compatibility: Officially available, not runtime-validated. All three original standalone controls must survive on this same VM before any Caper build. This cannot establish macOS 15 acceptance.
capturePolicy: Generated schemes gain keepAlways system/user attachments and screenRecording preference. ax-capture.patch adds eight observation-only lines to the two existing screenshot helpers: keepAlways debugDescription attachments. No application or assertion changes. AX reads can add timing overhead. Successful UI acceptance requires exported recording and AX snapshot evidence plus subsequent inspection, not merely a green aggregate. No permission/default/focus/rendering changes. No app reruns.
desktopPolicy: Read-only preflight requires visible frame at least 1440x900 for the unchanged wide tests. No resolution change; an undersized default hosted desktop fails before preparing/building Caper.
buildScope: Existing prepare.sh builds the shared mobile XCFramework's five Rust slices and fetches existing pinned dependencies, then generates the development project. Only the macOS Debug AppKit/core/view/UI host schemes are built; no iOS app, shipping app or Release app build.
testScope: 37 non-UI tests (14 MessageFormattingTests plus 23 AppKit view tests), then the six exact UI singleton selectors in native_acceptance.py, once each. Actual starts/ends, summary counts, exit/signal and evidence are gated. No retries; all six independent results are preserved even after a test failure.
